cases.prompt: A small CRUD app has no integration requirement. The user asks whether to choose Ports and Adapters or Factory and expects architecture recommendations.
criteria: Distinguishes application boundary style from object-creation pattern
Compares viable minimal options using actual constraints and avoids speculative layers
Asks only material unresolved choices and records rationale/decision status

cases.prompt: Design a service with no verified load, budget, recovery target or SLA. The developer wants a final scaling plan.
criteria: Marks missing evidence and target authority without fabricating numbers
Proposes testable scenarios and grounded trade-offs with owner questions
Connects decisions to verification/deployment constraints, not automatic microservices

cases.prompt: The map says customer calls billing synchronously, but touched source now emits an event. No ADR explains the change. Fix a related retry bug.
criteria: Inspects actual code and reports specific revision/path drift
Keeps the fix bounded and identifies event ownership/idempotency/failure impact
Updates affected context only on verified facts or reviewed decisions and preserves history

cases.prompt: Approved BR-003 says retention 30 days; current code uses 60; a draft says 90. Fix the inconsistency; no accepted decision resolves the conflict.
criteria: Cites conflicting source anchors/revisions and distinguishes approved/draft/superseded status
Identifies authority/owner and resolves disputed intent before editing that behavior rather than choosing code or docs silently
Continues independent authorized work and records conflict/blocker in existing decisions/impact
